description.value: Proud Up is a sit-down Canadian comfort food restaurant serving breakfast and dinner, formerly operating as The Taco Factory. The menu leans hearty — eggs Benedict variations, skillets, chicken and waffles — with a selection of vegetarian-friendly dishes. Located on East Columbia Street in New Westminster, it offers a relaxed neighbourhood dining experience for cyclists passing through.

address.value: 418 East Columbia St, New Westminster, BC V3L 3W9

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active Canadian comfort food restaurant at 418 East Columbia St, New Westminster, BC — the OSM community tag 'North Vancouver' is incorrect; the website consistently names New Westminster. Menu pages show vegetarian options (Veggo Benny, Cali Veggie, green fields skillet with tofu) and the ordering page confirms phone-based takeout. No bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
